corral-b6a8d277: `serializeComposerDraft` returns null for an empty draft and otherwise JSON that starts with `{"v":2`. `parseComposerDraft` reads anything else as a text draft, even text that starts with a brace. corral-dfdf14f9: `documentTabLabel` returns the file name when no other open document shares it. When one does and the paths differ, it returns `name — folder`.
